Atlas Hunt

Geography quiz: find countries, capitals and rivers on a map. Flags quiz too.

Free · 130+ games · Six languages · Works offline

✦✦

How it plays

No labels, no hints: only the countries, capitals and rivers on a blank map.

  1. Pick a game, find each place

    The game names a place; you find it on the map. A wrong tap shows what you touched; after the third miss the answer blinks.

  2. Every place opens a card

    Its picture and the start of its Wikipedia article, so you learn what it is, not only where.

  3. Go for a perfect run

    Every name on the first try. Your best score and time are kept for each game.

A whole atlas to play

130+ games on six levels, more on the way.

  • Earth

    Countries, capitals, rivers, mountain ranges, lakes, seas, islands, deserts and peninsulas of every part of the world, and the regions of 30+ countries.

  • Space

    The planets, the moons of Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune, the Moon's seas and craters, the constellations and brightest stars.

  • Flags

    See a flag and pick its country from four answers: the World and six parts of it.

  • Currencies

    A currency's name and sign, such as won ₩: whose is it?

  • Crossword

    Built from the places you pick, with clues from the atlas and a map hint for each. Share it as a PDF or a picture, or print it.

  • History

    The world as it was on 1 June 1816, in 1914 and in 1989.

See it in under a minute

Countries, a card, rivers, mountain ranges, seas, flags, currencies, the planets and their moons, the night sky and a crossword: real play on a phone.

Everything else

  • Works offline

    Every map and game works without the internet. Only the card's text and picture need it.

  • Six languages

    English, Danish, Italian, Romanian, Russian and Ukrainian: choose in Settings, or follow your phone.

  • Fair to your fingers

    A tiny country is a circle you can hit; a tap near the river you are asked for counts.

  • Achievements and leaderboards

    With Google Play Games: perfect runs, daily streaks, Globetrotter, and leaderboards for every part of the world.

  • Your results, everywhere

    Signed in, your results and trophies follow you to other devices.

  • Phones, tablets and PCs

    On tablets, foldables and PCs the games and cards sit beside the map; zoom with the mouse wheel.

No account. No analytics of its own.

The app itself collects nothing: your results stay on your phone, or in Google Play Games if you sign in. Cards ask Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons for their text and picture. The free version's banner comes from Google AdMob, which asks for your consent first in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland. Read the privacy policy
